name: Embedded Observer Accessibility Constraints Registry
purpose: Define bounded reconstruction limits arising from embedded participation within projection systems.

observer_constraints.definition: The observer cannot access the source relation from an external viewpoint; all access is mediated through projected aspect roles.
The projection containing the observer cannot fully describe its own source-relation mapping.
Analysis tools generated within a projection inherit the deformation modes of that projection.
Sequential measurements within an embedded neighborhood distort the remaining recoverable residue.
Reconstruction accessibility is limited by the set of reference aspect roles available to the embedded observer.

accessibility_bounds.definition: Accessibility is strictly limited to the observer's local neighborhood.
Partial reconstruction is possible but subject to mandatory structural gaps.
Accessibility is blocked at neighborhood boundaries by irreducible conflicts.
Total reconstruction is blocked by the impossibility of external viewpoint metadata.

governance_rules.rule: Every reconstruction claim must specify the observer's embeddedness status and associated constraints.
Claims of 'objective externality' or 'complete reconstruction' trigger immediate REJECT_ESCALATION.

forbidden_claims: Embedded observers can prove the full source relation.
Tooling bias can be completely eliminated through refinement.
Accessibility bounds derive the Heisenberg uncertainty principle.
